name: Clipper2
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: Robust 2D polygon booleans, offsetting and triangulation; Node via the clipper2-wasm port
summary: Clipper2 clips polygons (union, intersection, difference, XOR), offsets them with miter, round or square joins, takes Minkowski sums and triangulates. VCR reaches it through the clipper2-wasm npm port, which runs in Node with no native build and returns point arrays that scripts write as SVG. Its strength is a robust integer-scaled engine for outline, inset and shape-union work on flattened curves.
use_when: Outset or inset an outline with round or mitered joins for stroke, glow or inline effects
Union or subtract many overlapping polygons into clean rings; over paper-js on hard overlap cases
Polygon geometry in plain Node, with no canvas, DOM or browser
Inset-and-hatch or offset-contour fills that feed a plotter path set
avoid_when: Bezier-native booleans that keep curves: paper-js
3D solids or meshes: build123d or trimesh
Optimising or hatching plotter paths: vpype
Plain SVG drawing with no geometry operations: svg
notes: 2026-11-27: AngusJohnson/Clipper2 is archived; its README says development moved to PolyClipping/Clipper2 (BSL-1.0, pushed 2026-11-12). clipper2-wasm 0.4.0 is by Erik Sombroek (ErikSom/Clipper2-WASM, last push 2026-05-18); which Clipper2 release it bundles is not stated in its package.
2026-11-27: BSL-1.0 is the Boost Software License, permissive, not the Business Source License.
2026-11-27: input must be flattened polygons; flattening tolerance and the decimal precision argument decide the output, so record both.

assessment.rationale: Upstream AngusJohnson/Clipper2 retired in favour of PolyClipping/Clipper2 (2.0.1 release 2026-10-26, pushed 2026-11-12, BSL-1.0). npm clipper2-wasm 0.4.0 published 2026-05-18, BSL-1.0, one maintainer. No other catalogue route does robust 2D offsetting.

evidence.result: Union, round outset, miter inset and difference to SVG twice in separate Node 22.19.0 processes: identical SHA-256, union 1 ring/79 vertices, difference 2 rings area 21098.5 vs analytic 21098.6; resvg 0.47.0 PNG 960x300 inspected.
evidence.scope: clipper2-wasm 0.4.0 double API (UnionD, InflatePathsD, DifferenceD), precision 2, 96-segment arcs, macOS arm64; not Minkowski, triangulation, open paths, browser or performance.
